meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to

examples.trans: We came as soon as we could.
Will you be able to come tomorrow morning?

управлять.gloss: to manage, to run, to govern

meanings.note: govern or direct an organization, city, or vehicle; + instrumental

examples.trans: It is very hard to manage it.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: I'll definitely buy you a tank.
I know this town really well!

получиться.gloss: to turn out, to work out

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: всё получилось = it all worked out

meanings.en: to come out of, to make
meanings.note: из тебя получится мэр = you'll make a mayor
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: В моей комнате раньше дядя Миша жил.
examples.trans: Uncle Misha used to live in my room.
There used to be an old park here.

meanings.note: adds a reason or an obvious truth

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
The wind is blowing hard outside.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

уметь.gloss: to know how to, to be able to

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: to cut, to slice, to carve

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.note: plant or part of plant used as food

examples.trans: Chop fresh vegetables for the salad.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.
We need to do even more.

examples.text: Я защищаю человека от твоей злости.
examples.trans: I protect a person from your anger.
Anger could be heard in his voice.

собраться.gloss: to get ready, plan to, gather

meanings.en: to intend, plan, get ready to

examples.text: Ты что, уходить от меня собрался?
examples.trans: Are you planning to leave me or what?

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: How much power does this car have?

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.
I can see the toy car.
